children: Japan's export growth is likely to moderate gradually over the coming quarters, says Oxford Economics economist Norihiro Yamaguchi. Robust artificial-intelligence demand should continue to underpin shipments of tech-related goods, he says. However, he adds: "Shipments of non-AI capital goods and big-ticket items such as autos are likely to face increasing headwinds from elevated energy prices and borrowing costs globally." Government data earlier Wednesday showed Japan's exports rose 20.5% on year in October, accelerating from September's 16.5% increase. (megumi.fujikawa@wsj.com)
